high_signal_works.summary_zh: 公司预览报告在 9 类衣物、785 次内部试验中报告 99.1±0.3% 成功率；范围排除若干衣物类型，标注由公司完成，未独立复现。
high_signal_works.title: ACT-2 Preview

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 公司报告研究约 9,000 种生成式末端执行器变化下的跨形态学习；该数字不是 9,000 款实体商业机械手。
high_signal_works.title: Towards Machines with a Thousand Hands

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 将长时 VLA 拆成高频 Executor、工作记忆 Sentry 和慢速 Planner，并用可增删改的跨模态记忆在真实机器人上处理非马尔可夫任务。
high_signal_works.title: HiMe: Hierarchical Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Control

high_signal_works.summary_zh: Distributed Robotics Lab 官方组页发布 FloatForm 动态：微型水面机器人以分布式控制协同自组装为可重构浮动结构。
high_signal_works.title: Tiny robot boats that build floating structures

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 用超过 100K 小时 UMI 真实轨迹和自动语言标注预训练基础 VLA，展示数据与模型规模向真实机器人零样本和少样本能力传导。
high_signal_works.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以未来视觉 latent 监督学习 action-conditioned 时空触觉表征，在部署零额外开销下适配预训练 VLA。
high_signal_works.title: τ: Learning Touch-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Models from Future Visual Supervision

high_signal_works.summary_zh: WITA-Omni 以 Thinker–Talker–Actor 架构统一音视频理解、决策、语音、运动和表情生成，作为交互智能模块与操作和运动智能并行演进。
high_signal_works.title: AGIBOT’s WITA-Omni Preview Tops Daily-Omni Audio-Visual Reasoning Benchmark

high_signal_works.summary_zh: Gemini Robotics 2 同时推进全身 VLA、具身推理高层脑、端侧模型、多机器人协作与 agentic safety。
high_signal_works.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 证明末端执行器轨迹等行为对齐表征可以绕开关节空间差异，将多本体数据真正转化为新本体增益。
high_signal_works.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 让 VLM 提案、动作条件世界模型预演，再用优化与搜索修改计划，把 world model 从表象生成推向决策空间。
high_signal_works.title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 把真实家庭改造为同步采集工厂，将第一/第三人称视频、全身与手部运动、物体轨迹、音频和触觉对齐到同一交互流。
high_signal_works.title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 将真机部署奖励转换为托管 SFT API 可接受的监督数据，在不访问权重、梯度或损失的情况下形成两轮部署飞轮。
high_signal_works.title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
